azureLogAnalytics.query:
let hay_error =
    AppServiceConsoleLogs
    | where ResultDescription contains "Invalid access token"
    | summarize total = count();

hay_error
| extend status = iff(total > 0, "ALERT", "OK")
| extend color = case(
    status == "ALERT", "#f7f304ff",   // amarillo alerta
    "#EAF4EA"                         // verde OK
)
| extend color = trim(' "\t\r\n', tostring(color))
| project color

//============================var_ant_MT_ingesta_NotPII===============================
//Resumen actualizacion not pii OK
let NotPii =
Logs_ANT_Mineral_Tracking_datamart_CL
| where origin_module == "Tabla PI System"
| where isnotempty(detail)
| top 1 by TimeGenerated
| extend mensaje_a_consultar = parse_json(detail)
| extend  
    tabla = tostring(mensaje_a_consultar.tabla),
    alertar = iif(alertar == true, "Alertar", "No Alertar")
| project key = 1, NotPii = alertar; 

// ==== COLOR PARA INGESTAS ====
NotPii
| extend color = iif(NotPii == "Alertar", "#E53935", "#EAF4EA") //E53935 E53935
| extend color = trim(' "\t\r\n', tostring(color))
| project color
// Fallback verde si no hay datos
| union (datatable(color:string) ['#EAF4EA']) //EAF4EA
| extend _pref = iif(color == '#EAF4EA', 0, 1)
| top 1 by _pref desc
| project color

let bins_expected_logs = view() { 
  range TimeGeneratedBin_Chile from $__timeFrom to $__timeTo step 15m
  | extend TimeGeneratedBin_Chile = datetime_utc_to_local(bin(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile, 15m), 'America/Santiago'),
           expected_log_write_recommendations = 1,
           expected_log_write_data_graph = 1,
           expected_log_write_status = 1
  | extend expected_log_write_threshold = iif(hourofday(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile) == 17 and datetime_part('minute', TimeGeneratedBin_Chile) == 0, 1, 0)
  | extend lastFriday = iif(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile >= startofweek(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile) + 5d + 23h,
                            startofweek(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile, 1) - 2d + 23h,
                            startofweek(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile, 0) - 2d + 23h)
  | extend expected_log_write_kpi = iif(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile == lastFriday, 1, 0)
  | project-away lastFriday
};

let alertLogs = view () {
    SparkLoggingEvent_CL
        | where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo
        | where log_logger_s == "SIRO_POTENCIA"
            and Message has '"alert": "false"'
            and Message has_any ("log_write_recommendations", "log_write_data_graph", "log_write_status", "log_write_threshold", "log_write_kpi")
        | order by TimeGenerated desc
        | extend TimeGenerated = TimeGenerated + 2m // A veces queda fuera de rango la ejecución
        | extend id_log = parse_json(Message).id, 
                 TimeGeneratedBin_Chile = datetime_utc_to_local(bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), 'America/Santiago')
        | project TimeGeneratedBin_Chile, id_log
        | summarize real_log_write_recommendations = count(id_log=="log_write_recommendations"),
                    real_log_write_data_graph      = count(id_log=="log_write_data_graph"),
                    real_log_write_status          = count(id_log=="log_write_status"),
                    real_log_write_threshold       = count(id_log=="log_write_threshold"),
                    real_log_write_kpi             = count(id_log=="log_write_kpi") 
          by TimeGeneratedBin_Chile
};

// =============================
// BASE: BINS + LOGS REALES
// =============================
let base = 
    bins_expected_logs
    | join kind=leftouter (alertLogs) on TimeGeneratedBin_Chile
    // no se utiliza la ultima fila porque puede quedar fuera de rango
    | take toscalar(bins_expected_logs | count) - 1 
    | extend real_log_write_recommendations = coalesce(real_log_write_recommendations, 0),
             real_log_write_data_graph      = coalesce(real_log_write_data_graph, 0),
             real_log_write_status          = coalesce(real_log_write_status, 0),
             real_log_write_threshold       = coalesce(real_log_write_threshold, 0),
             real_log_write_kpi             = coalesce(real_log_write_kpi, 0)
    | extend TimeGeneratedBin_UTC = datetime_local_to_utc(TimeGeneratedBin_Chile, 'America/Santiago');

// =============================
// TOMAMOS EL ÚLTIMO BIN VÁLIDO
// =============================
let ultimo_bin = 
    base
    | top 1 by TimeGeneratedBin_UTC desc;

// =============================
// RESUMEN POR TIPO DE LOG + ALERTA + COLOR
// =============================
let resumen =
    union
    (
        ultimo_bin
        | extend Componente = "log_write_recommendations",
                 Esperados  = expected_log_write_recommendations,
                 Reales     = real_log_write_recommendations
        | project Componente, Esperados, Reales
    ),
    (
        ultimo_bin
        | extend Componente = "log_write_data_graph",
                 Esperados  = expected_log_write_data_graph,
                 Reales     = real_log_write_data_graph
        | project Componente, Esperados, Reales
    ),
    (
        ultimo_bin
        | extend Componente = "log_write_status",
                 Esperados  = expected_log_write_status,
                 Reales     = real_log_write_status
        | project Componente, Esperados, Reales
    ),
    (
        ultimo_bin
        | extend Componente = "log_write_threshold",
                 Esperados  = expected_log_write_threshold,
                 Reales     = real_log_write_threshold
        | project Componente, Esperados, Reales
    ),
    (
        ultimo_bin
        | extend Componente = "log_write_kpi",
                 Esperados  = expected_log_write_kpi,
                 Reales     = real_log_write_kpi
        | project Componente, Esperados, Reales
    );

resumen
| extend Estado = iif(Esperados > Reales, "Alertar", "No Alertar")
| extend Color  = iif(Estado == "Alertar", "#FDE2E2", "#EAF4EA")
| project Estado, Color

fn_prd_mlp_ssag_dom_resumen_status(ago(3h), now())
| extend estados = pack_all()
| mv-expand componente = bag_keys(estados)
| extend componente = tostring(componente)
| extend estado = tostring(estados[componente])
| summarize estado = iff(countif(estado == "ALERT") > 0, "ALERT", "OK")
| project color = fn_mon_status_to_color(estado)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// ===== Volumetría → color único (ALERT si hay alguna alerta) =====
let Base =
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerGroupName_s startswith "ams-dev-caj-hrep-job-rep-ppfm-01"
| extend j = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend capa = tostring(j.log_capa), mensaje_txt = tostring(j.mensaje)
| where capa contains "INGESTA/VOLUMETRIA"
| extend msg_sin = replace_string(replace_string(mensaje_txt, "{", ""), "}", "")
| extend json_txt = strcat("{", replace_string(msg_sin, "'", "\""), "}")
| extend d = parse_json(json_txt)
| extend Fuente = tostring(d.source)
| where Fuente in~ ("siga","sercol")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Fuente
| extend estado_vol = iif(
    isnotnull(d.qty_records) and isnotnull(d.lower_bound) and isnotnull(d.upper_bound)
    and (toint(d.qty_records) < toint(d.lower_bound) or toint(d.qty_records) > toint(d.upper_bound)),
    "Alertar", "No Alertar"
);

// ¿Hay alguna alerta?
Base
| extend tiene_alerta = iif(estado_vol == "Alertar", 1, 0)
| summarize any_alerta = max(tiene_alerta)
// Color + (fallback verde si no hay datos)
| extend color = iif(any_alerta == 1, "#E53935", "#EAF4EA")
| project color
| union (datatable(color:string) ['#EAF4EA'])
| extend _pref = iif(color == '#EAF4EA', 0, 1)
| top 1 by _pref desc
| project color
